reason: User requests entire datasets where possible. The earlier MP4-only basename guard incorrectly rejected 2200 eligible official source names before network access.
selection: All eligible official IDs; no count cap, caption filtering or score-based replacement. Preserve official splits.
license_scope: CC BY 2.0 and CC BY-SA 2.0 with source attribution. This is the entire eligible cohort, not the entire official benchmark; other license categories remain excluded.
ingestion: Safe original basenames allow original upload extensions; AWS supplies MP4 bytes. Four network workers. Record every failure, hash and decoder geometry. Retain all valid available media and all corresponding human queries.
integrity: Coalesce within-split exact-media aliases retaining all queries. Resolve any cross-split identical media before fitting using a documented source-only policy. Never pad malformed decoder geometry or change temporal targets.
prior_results: Earlier 364/73/47-video results are historical subset results. The 161-query prior test is observed and overlaps the expanded test; expanded evaluation cannot be described as wholly fresh or blind.
training: Rebuild all cached features and retrain prespecified adapters on the corrected complete available eligible cohort. Retain pretrained baseline. Use every validation query; no evaluation sampling.
selection_rule: Primary corpus consensus R@1 IoU>=0.5, minimum absolute gain0.01; within-video mIoU drop <=0.01. Same phase-1 and conditional followup configuration grids, three seeds, fixed cosine mixture weights, unchanged stopping and tie rules.
evaluation: Freeze final expanded-cohort choice before any new test predictions. Evaluate every query for every retained test video once; report exact official/eligible/available/valid counts and prior test exposure. Do not tune on expanded or historical test results.
publication: Do not promote historical subset scores as entire-dataset results. Publish current coverage and measured completed full-available-cohort results with explicit licensing/access/quality exclusions. No raw media, captions or weights in Git.
